messages:
zoe-docs: Quick heads-up — we need a short "Function vs Tool calling" migration cheat-sheet for structured output. Multiple teams confused about when to use function-calling typed args vs tool-calling for rich JSON blobs. Can someone draft examples + a tiny SDK snippet?

pat-ml: Yep. Core guidance: use function-calling when the contract is small, typed, and you want strict validation + automatic argument mapping. Use tool-calling when you accept large or third-party outputs (documents, logs, tables) and include a lightweight meta header (schema_version, content_type).

sam-sdk: I can add a compact SDK helper that validates tool outputs against a JSON Schema and optionally normalizes to a stable envelope. Draft snippet for docs (py/ts) will show parse+validate with a permissive fallback.

li-eng: Docs should include two canonical envelopes: 1) function-call example: { name: "extract_entities", arguments: { text: "...", max_entities: 10 } } and 2) tool-call example: { tool_output: { meta: { schema_version: "1.0", content_type: "application/json+rdw" }, payload: { title: "...", items: [...] } } }. Call out streaming caveat (streams can split inside strings) and recommend server-side escaping or array-of-lines if producers append.

ana-qa: I'll add a tiny netcat repro for chunked stream behavior and a test matrix: correct function-call flows, tool-call with escaped newlines, tool-call with array-of-lines, and malformed streams. We'll assert SDK helper normalizes successful cases and triggers a telemetry flag on fallbacks.

preview-bot: docs-preview: built zoe/function-tool-cheatsheet -> https://docs-preview.internal/branches/zoe/function-tool-cheatsheet/index.html (expires in 72h) :rocket:

zoe-docs: Plan: short cheat-sheet < 300 words, two envelope examples, Python + TypeScript SDK examples (parse-and-validate + normalize), netcat repro snippet for streaming split, migration checklist (bump SDK, enable helper opt-in, update producers to include meta or use array-of-lines), and note about telemetry for one release. Opening PR and tagging @sam-sdk + @ana-qa for review. Thanks! :thumbsup:
